test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - GA (Held On 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)

concept: Person in News, Appointments and Resignations
question: Who among the following became the brand ambassador of ASICS in April 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ravindra Jadeja.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **ASICS** has named** Ravindra Jadeja,** an all-rounder for the Indian cricket team and a member of the Chennai Super Kings, as its** brand ambassador.**
 
• ASICS specializes in producing** sports equipment** for a variety of sports.
 
• **Ravindrasinh Anirudhsinh Jadeja** is an** Indian international cricketer.**
 
• He is an** all-rounder, who bats left-handed** and bowls **left-arm orthodox spin.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tiger Shroff:**

 
 
• Tiger Shroff is an **Indian Bollywood actor** who has been appointed as brand ambassador by APL Apollo Tubes Limited (APL Apollo), India's leading branded steel pipes manufacturer.
 
• He is the ambassador for its exclusive product line** 'Apollo Column'.**
 
 
 
• **Virat Kohli:**
 
 
• Virat Kohli is an **Indian international cricketer** and** former captain **of the India national cricket team.
 
• He plays for **Royal Challengers Bangalore** in the** Indian Premier League **as a right-handed batsman.
 
• He is the brand ambassador for various companies like Blue Star, Himalaya, Myntra, Google Duo, Mobile Premier League, Amaze (Inverters and Batteried), Puma, Hero MotoCorp, Sun Pharma-Volini Wrogn, Audi India, Manyavar, American Tourister Bags, Vicks India, Uber India, MRF Tyres etc.
 
 
 
• **Deepika Padukone:**
 
 
• Deepika Padukone is an **Indian Bollywood actress.**
 
• **Adidas **roped in Deepika Padukone as a **Global brand ambassador.**
